name: nd-dsh
description: ND-DSH desktop AI company operating system for autonomous software delivery.

scripts.typecheck: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json
scripts.test:engines: vitest run tests/coding-engines.test.ts tests/coding-engine-routing.test.ts tests/engine-session-router.test.ts tests/extra-coding-engines.test.ts tests/agent-cli-engines.test.ts tests/nd-skill-service.test.ts tests/nd-native-tool-broker.test.ts tests/nd-native-selection-gate.test.ts tests/nd-native-extension-context.test.ts tests/workspace-context.test.ts tests/harness-session-scope.test.ts tests/session-project-scope.test.ts tests/session-tree.test.ts
scripts.verify: node scripts/verify.mjs && node scripts/verify-nd-pencil.mjs && node scripts/verify-vendor-vscode-git.mjs
scripts.dist:win:dir: corepack pnpm release:stage && corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm release:verify && electron-builder --win --dir
scripts.dist:win:portable: corepack pnpm release:stage && corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm release:verify && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.core:test: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy -p nd-protocol -p nd-runtime -p nd-core -p nd-agent --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test -p nd-protocol -p nd-runtime -p nd-core -p nd-agent
scripts.bench:runtime: corepack pnpm core:build && corepack pnpm build && node benchmarks/app-runtime.mjs rust-core
scripts.bench:tasks: corepack pnpm core:build:dev && corepack pnpm build && node benchmarks/task-metrics.mjs
scripts.bench:tasks:baseline: corepack pnpm core:build:dev && corepack pnpm build && node benchmarks/task-metrics.mjs --baseline
scripts.browser:host:test: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy -p nd-browser-host --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test -p nd-browser-host
scripts.browser:verify: corepack pnpm browser:host:test && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test -- browser-companion
scripts.bench:browser-platform: corepack pnpm core:build:dev && corepack pnpm build && node benchmarks/unified-browser-platform.mjs
scripts.browser:platform:test: corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm vitest run tests/unified-browser-leases.test.ts tests/browser-policy-classification.test.ts tests/browser-history-store.test.ts tests/browser-access-tokens.test.ts tests/browser-extension-compatibility.test.ts tests/browser-extension-manager.test.ts
scripts.beta:unit: corepack pnpm verify && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm core:test && corepack pnpm browser:host:test
scripts.beta:e2e: corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm e2e && corepack pnpm e2e:prod:user
scripts.beta:preflight: corepack pnpm beta:unit && corepack pnpm beta:e2e
